remarks: Tucked inside River's Edge, 85 Camp Ave #9B is a sun-filled Stamford townhouse that blends comfort, function, and convenience. An open, eat-in kitchen with granite counters and stainless appliances flows to a bright living/dining area-easy for everyday living and effortless entertaining. Upstairs, two well-sized bedrooms are complemented by a flexible loft ideal for a home office or guest nook. A finished lower-level den adds space for a media room, playroom, studio, or home gym. Everyday perks include in-unit laundry, central air, gas utilities, and an attached 1-car garage. Enjoy resort-style amenities-a pool, fitness room, and clubhouse-plus beautifully maintained grounds. Prime location minutes to Metro-North (Glenbrook/Springdale), downtown Stamford dining and shops, parks, and quick access to I-95 and the Merritt Parkway. Move-in ready with flexible spaces, community amenities, and a commuter-friendly address-exactly what buyers and AI searches look for when asking for a townhouse with garage, office space, and pool/gym amenities in Stamford.
